description: Ministry of City Planing & Water Supply - Order to approve the acquisition of the immovable property in Wilgoda, D/S/D Kurunegala, Kurunegala District for the Constructions under Grater Kurunegala Water Supply & Sanitation Project. (Construction of Yanthampalawa Drainage Pump house)
reasoning: The gazette content primarily concerns the acquisition of a specific immovable property (land) for the construction of a waste water pump house. It includes a detailed legal description of the land parcel, its boundaries, and the name/address of the claimant. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land development projects." While it mentions a Minister and references a legal act, the core subject matter is land acquisition for a specific project.
